title: calamus hirsutus subsp. minor
intro: Calamus hirsutus subsp. minor, commonly known as lesser calamus or minor sweet flag, is a plant species in the family Zingiberaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of calamus hirsutus subsp. minor are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating insomnia, coughs, and colds. The plant's bioactive constituents include volatile oils, phenolic compounds, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
